name: Have You Been Paying Attention?
description: Topical comedy-quiz show featuring five guests competing to see who can remember the most about events of the week. A fast-paced, funny look at international affairs, politics, sport and entertainment news, we test just how well our contestants have been paying attention.

videos.title: Season 2 Episode 3 - Uncut
videos.overview: This is the uncut version of tonight's episode. According to HYBPA's twitter feed it's "Full of stuff we couldn't fit in/not allowed to at 6. Warning: may contain adult themes and Ed Kavalee naked". This week's guest panel are: Ed Kavalee, Jane Kennedy, Ronny Chieng, Kate Langbroek, and Sam Pang.
